innovation.text: Travel Planner V3 was built in Microsoft Excel as a macro-enabled workbook.
Travel Planner V3 is built in Microsoft Excel as a macro-enabled workbook.
The tool aims to simplify the process of planning trips by storing all supporting travel information in a single, unified tool.
The application features an elegant and logically designed interface with easy-to-use navigation.
A static sidebar is always on the left for the main tab with navigation buttons and a Travel Summary.
The application automates all possible actions and includes mini pop-up calendars for date selection.
The application follows a 'scroll-less' design principle, providing everything needed at a glance or with a simple click.
The application allows users to automatically see who saved the workbook last and when.
The application displays the date and time whenever users search for flights, hotels, or cars.
